text:
Type: pine three-drawer cabinet
Use: storing clothes, tools and small items; bedroom, hallway, home office, workroom
Style: Scandinavian, rustic, minimalist
Materials: solid untreated knotty pine
Colors: pale natural pine, warm honey knots
Shape: plain wide box with three flush drawers, handleless fronts, flat top, sits straight on the floor or inside a shelving unit, simple and sturdy, box-like
Feel: natural, honest, simple, warm
Goes with: white walls, pine shelving, linen and wool textiles; Scandinavian or rustic rooms

product.name: IVAR
product.description: Untreated solid wood is a durable natural material which is even more hardwearing and easy to look after if you oil or wax the surface.
